name: bachsproof
description: BachsProof is a financial correctness testing framework for applications integrating Bachs. It complements existing webhook testing tools by enabling developers to verify payment processing, idempotency, concurrency safety and financial integrity within their applications.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.pack:check: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @bachsproof/core pack --pack-destination ./reports && pnpm --filter @bachsproof/bachs pack --pack-destination ./reports && pnpm --filter @bachsproof/cli pack --pack-destination ./reports
